species.real: In some deep-sea anglerfish the tiny male bites the female, fuses into her body for life and shares her blood, until he is little more than a pair of testes.
species.name: Glimmerjaw

dex.text: Hangs in the dark with its little lamp held out on a rod, and waits. Anything curious enough to come and look finds out what all the teeth are for.
dex.fact: Deep-sea anglerfish lure prey with a glowing tip on a spine that grows from their head. The light is made by bacteria living inside it, and in some species the tiny males fuse onto the female for life.
